description: Find Cestrian Capital Research notes by ticker, by words in the title, or both; newest first. Returns title, date, summary, link and whether the note is free to read. Follow up with get_note to read one.

free_only.description: Only notes with no paywall. Default false.

limit.description: How many notes to return. Default 5.

query.description: Words to look for in note titles, e.g. "datacenter" or "earnings review".

ticker.description: Limit to notes about this ticker, e.g. "LUMN".

name: search_research
title: Search Cestrian research notes
